candidates.review_note: For fixed positive endpoint displacement vector d, g=gcd(d) gives g-1 interior lattice points; choose c-2 of them. Translations number product(m_i-d_i). Let f(g)=binomial(g-1,c-2); divisor inversion constructs h with f(g)=sum_{k|g} h(k). Exchange sums: each dimension contributes sum_{t=1..floor((m_i-1)/k)} (m_i-k*t). Thus sum h(k) times product of these arithmetic sums. Lucas binomials modulo prime10007 cover dimensions exceeding the modulus. Counts strictly coordinate-increasing point sets once by ordered endpoints. O(M log M+nM), M=min(m_i)-1. Missing global numeric bounds are not invented; published large sample plus wider independent arithmetic checks establish measured range.
